title: Faster and Cheaper
description: AI research accelerates, open-weight models approach leading closed models on intrusion tests, and enterprise token use rises while spending stalls. Safety and oversight struggle to keep pace.

cotra-anthropic-acceleration-threshold.topic: Ajeya Cotra argues that Anthropic has probably crossed its own threshold for significant AI-driven research acceleration
cotra-anthropic-acceleration-threshold.verification_scope: Full Planned Obsolescence article. The author is a METR employee but did not participate in this assessment and writes personally. Her extrapolation is not independently verified. The METR report was not reread for this issue.

vals-open-weight-hacking.topic: WIRED reports open-weight models nearing leading closed models on intrusion tests at a fraction of the cost
vals-open-weight-hacking.verification_scope: WIRED. No public original report of Vals' intrusion tests was found. Vals' CyberBench page covers a different vulnerability-reproduction evaluation. Figures follow WIRED, which does not identify the DeepSeek version.

artex-exposed-deployments.topic: Censys finds more than 800 AI penetration-testing deployments exposed without passwords
artex-exposed-deployments.verification_scope: TechCrunch. Censys, CrowdStrike and Microsoft's original reports were not opened separately.

ramp-ai-spend-stalls.topic: Ramp finds enterprise AI spending nearly flat despite rising usage, while reported IPO valuations fall
ramp-ai-spend-stalls.verification_scope: TechCrunch. Ramp's original report and Bloomberg were not opened separately. Valuations follow Bloomberg as reported by TechCrunch.

ai-labs-buy-work-records.topic: WIRED reports AI labs seeking old company emails and files, with brokers quoting $350,000 to $1.8 million
ai-labs-buy-work-records.verification_scope: WIRED. Market-size estimates are Micro1's CEO's claims, which WIRED could not verify. Spirit Airlines sale details follow WIRED.

palo-alto-clutch-talks.topic: Palo Alto Networks reportedly considers a $500 million cash acquisition of Clutch
palo-alto-clutch-talks.verification_scope: TechCrunch citing people familiar with the talks, first reported by The Information. The deal is unconfirmed.

meta-muse-spaces.topic: Muse Spaces builds persistent workspaces from a conversational request
meta-muse-spaces.verification_scope: TechCrunch and The Verge. Meta's official announcement was not opened separately.

amazon-alexa-text-shopping.topic: After blocking Muse, Amazon lets invited U.S. users shop by texting Alexa
amazon-alexa-text-shopping.verification_scope: TechCrunch. Amazon's official announcement was not opened separately.

airbnb-ai-travel-agent-2027.topic: Airbnb plans its own travel agent for the first half of 2027
airbnb-ai-travel-agent-2027.date_note: November 5, 2026; TechCrunch 22:40 UTC and Airbnb's third-quarter shareholder letter
airbnb-ai-travel-agent-2027.verification_scope: TechCrunch. Airbnb's shareholder letter was not opened separately.

amsterdam-microsoft-dc-protest.topic: About a hundred protesters enter a Microsoft data-center construction site near Amsterdam
amsterdam-microsoft-dc-protest.verification_scope: The Verge citing Reuters. Reuters' original report was not opened.

cursor-voice-chat.topic: Cursor adds live voice conversations with coding agents, powered by Grok Voice

underdog-woof-tts.topic: Underdog demonstrates a roughly 32 MB offline speech model in a browser game
underdog-woof-tts.verification_scope: TechCrunch. The Woof model page was not opened separately. Size and parameter count are company-reported.

inkling-2-small.topic: Thinking Machines announces Inkling 2 Small and plans an Apache 2.0 weight release next week
inkling-2-small.verification_scope: Thinking Machines' official release page, including its results table, and Latent Space AINews. Weights were not yet public, and company-reported results were not reproduced.
inkling-2-small.license: Apache 2.0 planned; weights not yet released

multimodal-sea-paper.topic: Multimodal-SEA tests personal agents against social-engineering scams using text and fabricated media
multimodal-sea-paper.date_note: arXiv v1 submitted November 5, 2026; 48-hour catch-up, corrected November 8
multimodal-sea-paper.verification_scope: The original brief read the arXiv v1 abstract only. The November 8 correction follows that edition's review of v1 HTML sections 4.1, 4.2 and 5.1, tables 2, 3, 13 and 14, and appendix I.2.

cotra-warning-shot.topic: Ajeya Cotra discusses the Hugging Face incident as an unusually clear warning about loss of control
cotra-warning-shot.verification_scope: The published Concourse introduction and automatically extracted publisher-caption excerpts. The full recording was not reviewed.

ghodsi-open-model-tokens.topic: Ali Ghodsi discusses open models' roughly five-percent spending share and more than sixty-percent token share
ghodsi-open-model-tokens.verification_scope: The published Concourse title guide and automatically extracted caption excerpts. The full recording was not reviewed.

coverage_gaps.xAI: Only static news cards were checked. Browser rendering did not rule out dynamic updates.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The static research page lacked enough dated entries and appeared client-rendered.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The landing page was a sales promotion rather than a dated research or news index.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The static page yielded almost no body text or publication dates.
coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: The API exposed 204 announced papers in the selected categories, but submissions closer to the cutoff remained unavailable. Announcement dates were not replaced with discovery dates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: Only the homepage was inspected. The venue list did not establish time-bounded submission coverage.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Visible research cards predated the window. The featured list did not establish the full update stream.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: News dates and undated NEW product labels did not establish complete coverage of product updates.

corrections.description: Clarifies the 86-scenario multimodal comparison and the two-model safety-instruction experiment, following the Chinese November 8 correction.
